formula: Display formula. Empty when formula_quarantine is true.
material_name: Name as written in the source.
property: sigma_total, sigma_bulk, sigma_gb, Ea, D_NMR, D_other, or D_tracer.
value: Conductivity in S/cm, diffusivity in cm2/s, or activation energy in eV.
T_K: Temperature in kelvin. Empty when the source did not give one.
method: Measurement method when the source named one.
ea_type: For activation energy: arrhenius, vtf_pseudo, nmr_slr, nmr_t1rho, two_region, or unknown.
ea_method_class: EIS Arrhenius, VTF, NMR spin-lattice, NMR T1rho, PFG, two-region, or unknown. The stored value is not shifted between classes.
tier: A is the stricter table cut. B passed the other checks and missed at least one Tier A condition.
license: Licence string of the source article. In the open file this is cc by.
structure_id: Materials Project or COD identifier when a structure was linked.
measured_only: False when every in-scope row of the paper is a citation. The measured view is the complement.
curated_gold: True when an agent checked the row against the source and kept it. Not a human audit.
material_key: Canonical material key. A doped garnet is not grouped with the undoped formula.
